source_identity: R2 M6 CN_SHORT_DRAMA_SHUANGWEN policy pack v1 (spec section 5.1, 5.3; donor-derived surface pinned to XucroYuri/huohuo)

rules.description: Exact Canon/branch/map lineage must hold; no runtime latest substitution.
Every source/target reference in the map and screenplay closes over real evidence.
Every map entry uses one of the nine frozen adaptation operations.
Scene and shot identity is exact and ordered; no silent reorder or duplicate.
KnowledgeState and secret constraints from Canon are never disclosed early or leaked.
State, prop, and location continuity holds across every adapted scene.
Content and profile digests bind exactly; no unverified reference is trusted.
Production candidate and master selection is exact-current, never stale.
hen/shuang/ji/pan fields parse and validate per the pinned Huohuo field grammar.
shuang_type, when present, is one of the six pinned closed values.
hen/shuang/ji/pan and shuang_type apply only under the pinned chapter 1-8 scope; chapter 9+ records these rules as NOT_APPLICABLE, and a Golden B slice is never assumed to equal a chapter.
